title: CONNECT-UDP HTTP/3 Request Policy Architecture
purpose: Define RFC 9298 HTTP/3 CONNECT-UDP request construction and successful-response validation before UDP tunnel setup.
design_summary: `Http3ConnectUdp` builds HTTP/3 Extended CONNECT headers with `:method` CONNECT, `:protocol` connect-udp, expanded `:scheme`, `:authority`, and `:path`, plus a true Capsule-Protocol field. It validates incoming request headers through the existing HTTP/3 header validator, requires the Capsule Protocol, rejects request content, validates successful responses as 2xx Capsule Protocol responses without content, and exposes a Boolean proceed/abort decision for clients.
data_and_state_considerations: The slice is header-policy only. It does not send HTTP frames, open UDP sockets, perform DNS resolution, allocate Context IDs, or proxy packets.
edge_cases_and_constraints: Request and successful-response content is rejected before proxying proceeds.
Non-2xx and Capsule-disallowed 2xx responses are treated as failed proxying attempts.
risks: HTTP/1.1 upgrade behavior remains a separate RFC 9298 slice.
UDP tunnel setup and Proxy-Status error reporting remain separate RFC 9298 slices.
HTTP Datagram Context ID framing remains separate from this request-policy helper.
